const LS_HOLDERS = "awn_admin_holders";

const DEFAULT_CHECKS = [

function loadJson(key, fallback) {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}
function fmtCountdown(sec) {
  if (sec < 0) sec = 0;
  const d = Math.floor(sec / 86400);
  const h = Math.floor(sec % 86400 / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor(sec % 3600 / 60);
  const s = sec % 60;
  return `${d}d ${String(h).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(s).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

  const log = useCallback((msg, kind) => {
    setLogs(
      (prev) => [
        { t: (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toLocaleTimeString(), msg, kind },
        ...prev.slice(0, 80)
      ]
    );
  }, []);
  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const st = await fetchLiveState();
      setTradingOn(st.isTradingEnabled);
      setSellOn(st.isSellEnabled);
      setLimitsOn(st.isDexLimitsEnabled);
      setDexPool(st.dexPool);
      setTreasury(fromUnits(st.treasury));
      setSupply(fromUnits(st.totalSupply));
      setCycleStart(st.cycleStart);
      setClaimActive(st.claimProgramActive);
      setChecks(
        (prev) => prev.map((c) => {
          if (c.id === "trading") return { ...c, done: st.isTradingEnabled };
          if (c.id === "sells") return { ...c, done: st.isSellEnabled };
          if (c.id === "treasury") return { ...c, done: st.treasury > 0n };
          if (c.id === "pool") return { ...c, done: !!st.dexPool };
          return c;
        })
      );
      const point = {
        t: (/* @__PURE__ */ new Date()).toLocaleTimeString(),
        buy: st.isTradingEnabled ? 1 : 0,
        sell: st.isSellEnabled ? 1 : 0,
        treasury: Number(fromUnits(st.treasury)) || 0
      };
      setChart((prev) => {
        const next = [...prev, point].slice(-24);
        localStorage.setItem(LS_CHART, JSON.stringify(next));
        return next;
      });
      log("Sync on-chain OK", "ok");
    } catch (e) {
      log(`Sync fail: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`, "err");
    }
  }, [log]);
  useEffect(() => {
    void refresh();

  const claimTimer = useMemo(() => {
    if (!claimActive || !cycleStart) {
      return { label: "Claim non attivo", value: "--" };
    }
    const unlock = cycleStart + CLAIM_PERIOD;
    const end = unlock + CLAIM_WINDOW;
    if (now < unlock) {
      return { label: "Sblocco claim tra", value: fmtCountdown(unlock - now) };
    }
    if (now <= end) {
      return { label: "FINESTRA CLAIM APERTA — chiude tra", value: fmtCountdown(end - now) };
    }
    return { label: "Finestra scaduta — prossimo ciclo", value: fmtCountdown(0) };
  }, [claimActive, cycleStart, now]);
  async function sendBoc(to, amount, body, label) {
    if (!wallet) {
      log("Collega AWN-Owner con TonConnect", "err");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await tonConnectUI.sendTransaction({
        validUntil: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1e3) + 300,
        messages: [
          {
            address: to,
            amount: amount.toString(),
            payload: body.toBoc().toString("base64")
          }
        ]
      });
      log(`${label} inviato — conferma in wallet`, "ok");
      setTimeout(() => void refresh(), 8e3);
    } catch (e) {
      log(`${label} errore: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`, "err");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }
  async function onLookupHolder() {
    if (!holderAddr.trim()) return;
    try {
      const info = await fetchHolder(holderAddr.trim());
      const bl = await isBlacklisted(holderAddr.trim());
      setHolderInfo(
        `bal=${fromUnits(info.balance)} | minPeriod=${fromUnits(info.minBalancePeriod)} | start=${fromUnits(info.periodStartBalance)} | claimedCycle=${info.claimedCycleId} | blacklisted=${bl}`
      );
      setTracked(
        (prev) => prev.includes(holderAddr.trim()) ? prev : [holderAddr.trim(), ...prev].slice(0, 40)
      );
      log(`Holder ${holderAddr.slice(0, 8)}… sync`, "ok");
    } catch (e) {
      setHolderInfo("Errore lettura");
      log(String(e), "err");
    }
  }
  async function onCheckBl() {
    try {
      const v = await isBlacklisted(blAddr.trim());
      setBlStatus(v ? "BLOCKED" : "clean");
    } catch (e) {
      setBlStatus("error");
      log(String(e), "err");
    }
  }
  function parseBatch(text) {
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const items = [];
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < lines.length; i += 2) {
      items.push({ to: lines[i], amount: toUnits(lines[i + 1]) });
    }
    return items;
  }
